description: This file implements the CommonTokenStream class for token management in the ANTLR parser framework, including token buffering, seeking, and filtering functionalities.

classes.name: CommonTokenStream
classes.description: A token stream implementation that loads tokens on demand from a TokenSource, buffers them, and provides various utilities for token access and filtering.

methods.name: NewCommonTokenStream
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new CommonTokenStream with a specified lexer and channel.

methods.name: GetAllTokens
methods.description: Returns all tokens currently buffered.

methods.name: Mark
methods.description: Marks the current position in the token stream (stub implementation).

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a marked position (stub implementation).

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the token stream to initial state, clearing buffer and flags.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Moves the current index to a specified position.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves the token at a specific index.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Advances the current position in the token stream, with EOF checks.

methods.name: Sync
methods.description: Ensures tokens are buffered up to a certain index.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches a specified number of tokens from the token source.

methods.name: GetTokens
methods.description: Retrieves a subset of tokens between start and stop indices, optionally filtered by token types.

methods.name: LA
methods.description: Lookahead method returning the token type of the token at a given lookahead position.

methods.name: lazyInit
methods.description: Initializes the buffer if not already initialized.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Performs initial buffer setup.

methods.name: GetTokenSource
methods.description: Returns the current token source.

methods.name: SetTokenSource
methods.description: Resets the token source and clears buffer.

methods.name: NextTokenOnChannel
methods.description: Finds the next token on a specified channel starting from an index.

methods.name: previousTokenOnChannel
methods.description: Finds the previous token on a specified channel from an index.

methods.name: GetHiddenTokensToRight
methods.description: Collects tokens on a specified channel to the right of a given token index.

methods.name: GetHiddenTokensToLeft
methods.description: Collects tokens on a specified channel to the left of a given token index.

methods.name: filterForChannel
methods.description: Filters tokens within a range by channel.

methods.name: GetSourceName
methods.description: Returns the source name of the token source.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Returns the number of buffered tokens.

methods.name: Index
methods.description: Returns the current index in the token stream.

methods.name: GetAllText
methods.description: Concatenates and returns all buffered token texts.

methods.name: GetTextFromTokens
methods.description: Returns concatenated text from two tokens.

methods.name: GetTextFromRuleContext
methods.description: Returns text covered by a rule context.

methods.name: GetTextFromInterval
methods.description: Returns concatenated text from a specified interval of tokens.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Fetches all tokens until EOF.

methods.name: adjustSeekIndex
methods.description: Adjusts seek index to the next token on the current channel.

methods.name: LB
methods.description: Returns the token k positions before the current index, skipping off-channel tokens.

methods.name: LT
methods.description: Returns the token k positions ahead, skipping off-channel tokens.

methods.name: getNumberOfOnChannelTokens
methods.description: Counts tokens on the current channel until EOF.
